# Diff viewer: file tree, unified/split view, highlight.js colouring

## What to build

The Changes tab of the right panel, on both pages, becomes a GitHub-quality diff viewer, built as a shared module `src/web/assets/diffview.js` on top of the existing `src/web/assets/diff.js`.

- **File tree** at the top:
  - one row per changed file: a status letter (A/M/D/R, coloured), the path with its directory part dimmed, `+x −y` and a small proportional bar
  - clicking a row scrolls to that file's diff
  - "Collapse all" / "Expand all" buttons
  - every file below has a sticky header (path, status, counts and a collapse chevron) and collapses on its own
- **Unified / Split** toggle:
  - unified is the default
  - split (side by side) is only enabled when the panel is ≥ 900px wide (otherwise it is disabled, with the tooltip "Widen the panel for split view")
  - the choice is saved in `localStorage['ge.diffMode']` (try/catch)
  - split rows pair each deletion run with the following addition run, with blank cells on the shorter side
- **Syntax highlighting** with the bundled highlight.js (`/assets/vendor/highlight/`):
  - the language comes from the file extension
  - each hunk's old-side and new-side text is highlighted **as a whole** and then split back into lines, so multi-line comments and strings colour correctly
  - files above 2,000 lines of diff fall back to plain text
  - highlighting runs lazily when a file scrolls into view (IntersectionObserver)
  - the hljs colours come from a dark theme in `diffview.css`, made of `.hljs-*` classes mapped to the `--syn-*` tokens plus a few new ones
- The rendering contract stays: every row still has `data-file`, `data-kind`, `data-old-line`, `data-new-line` and `data-hunk`, in **both** modes. In split mode each half-row is its own element with `data-side="old|new"`.
- The existing binary, truncated and large-file notices, and lazy loading of each file's diff on expand (`/changes/:id?file=` on the run page, `/api/changes?node=&file=` on the suite page), stay.

The previous slices delivered:

- `src/web/assets/diff.js`: `parseFileDiff(path, text)` → `{path, status, hunks:[{oldStart, oldLines, newStart, newLines, header, lines:[{kind, old, new, text}]}], binary}`, `renderDiff(pre, file, {onLine})`, `isLarge`, and `diff.css`
- `highlight-lite.js`, the old regex highlighter
- `src/web/assets/panel.js` `createPanel`, with `panel.tab("changes")` as a scrollable container and a known panel width
- the vendored highlight.js under `src/web/assets/vendor/highlight/`: `highlight.min.js` (ES module, default export `hljs`) and `languages/<lang>.min.js` (each with a default-exported grammar), with `src/web/assets/vendor/README.md` listing them

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `src/web/assets/diff.js`, `diff.css`, `highlight-lite.js`: the parser and renderer this builds on.
- `src/web/assets/panel.js`: how to get the panel width (or observe it) to enable split mode.
- `src/web/page.html`: the Changes tab filling code (`makeRow`, `updateRow`, `loadDiff`, totals). The review overlay card also renders diffs with `renderDiff` and `onLine` (single-line comments). Keep `onLine` working in unified mode. Split mode may leave `onLine` out (comments stay unified-only for now).
- `src/suite/page.html`: its Changes tab code (`makeRow`, `updateRow`, `loadDiff`) and its review diff.
- `src/runner/events.ts` L35–52: `ChangedFile` `{path, added, deleted, isNew?, isDeleted?, binary?}` and `NodeChanges` `{files, total}`. These are the inputs for the file tree.

## Patterns to follow

**Pure helpers (tested):**
```js
/** Pairs a hunk's lines into split rows: [{left?: DiffLine, right?: DiffLine}] */
export function toSplitRows(hunk) { /* del-run followed by add-run → zip; ctx → both sides */ }
/** Highlights text with hljs and returns one HTML string per input line, keeping open spans across line breaks. */
export function highlightLines(hljs, text, lang) { /* close open spans at each \n and reopen them on the next line */ }
/** Language id from a path ("src/a.ts" → "typescript", "x.py" → "python", unknown → null). */
export function langOf(path) {}
export function fileStatus(changedFile) { /* "A" | "D" | "M" (| "R" when known) */ }
```
`highlightLines` must be pure, taking `hljs` as an argument, so the test can pass the real module:
```ts
import hljs from "./vendor/highlight/highlight.min.js";
```
Register the languages lazily: the first time a language is needed, `const g = (await import(\`/assets/vendor/highlight/languages/${lang}.min.js\`)).default; hljs.registerLanguage(lang, g)`.

**Escaping**: hljs output is the only HTML set with `innerHTML`, and it escapes its input. Plain-text fallbacks use `textContent`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `src/web/assets/diffview.js` and `src/web/assets/diffview.css`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `toSplitRows`, `highlightLines`, `langOf`, `fileStatus`
  - `mountDiffView(container, { files, loadDiff(path) → Promise<FileDiff>, onLine?, mode })`: renders the file tree and the file sections, lazy-loads a file when it is expanded or scrolled into view, and re-renders the loaded files when the mode changes
  - `setWidth(px)` enables or disables split mode
  - CSS: file tree, sticky file headers, split grid (`grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr 48px 1fr`), hljs dark colours
- **GOTCHA**: `renderDiff` in `diff.js` stays the unified renderer. Extend it with an optional `highlighter` callback instead of duplicating it, and add a split renderer next to it.
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

### UPDATE `src/web/page.html` and `src/suite/page.html`

- **IMPLEMENT**: the Changes tab uses `mountDiffView` with the node's `view.changes.files` and the page's existing diff fetch. The panel's resize updates `setWidth`. The review overlay card's diff also uses `mountDiffView` in unified mode with `onLine`, so single-line comments keep working. Remove `highlight-lite.js` once nothing imports it.
- **VALIDATE**: build, then agent-browser on both pages: open a node and check the TypeScript colours, toggle split at a wide panel, click a file in the tree, and collapse all.

### CREATE `src/web/assets/diffview.test.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**:
  - `toSplitRows`: a pure add, a pure del, del+add of unequal lengths, ctx in between
  - `highlightLines` with the real hljs and typescript: a multi-line block comment keeps the comment class on every line; the line count is the same as the input; `<` is escaped
  - `langOf` for 10 extensions plus an unknown one
  - `fileStatus`
- **VALIDATE**: `npx vitest run src/web/assets`

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The Changes tab on both pages shows the file tree (status, path, `+/−`, bar), sticky file headers, and collapse/expand per file and for all files
- [ ] Unified is the default; split works only at a panel width of ≥ 900px; the mode survives a reload
- [ ] highlight.js colours TypeScript, Python, JSON, CSS, Markdown and the rest of the bundled languages correctly, including multi-line comments; files over 2,000 diff lines stay plain
- [ ] Rows keep the data attributes in both modes, and single-line review comments still work in unified mode
- [ ] Binary, truncated and lockfile notices still show
- [ ] `npx vitest run src/web/assets && npm test` pass, and agent-browser screenshots of unified and split view are in the report

## Validation commands

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npx eslint .
npx vitest run src/web
npm run build
```
